hints.title: Circumnavigation Guarantee
hints.text: Because the street is circular and bounded by k, walking k steps ensures you loop across the entire perimeter.

hints.title: Marking Street Houses
hints.text: Set an identifiable pattern by opening all doors across k consecutive moves.

hints.title: Closure Count Pass
hints.text: Walk around a second time, closing each open door and counting steps until encountering the first closed door.

hints.title: Two-Pass Circular Traversal

variables: k: upper bound on number of houses
complexity.notes: Two passes of length at most k along the circular street.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Moving without marking cannot distinguish whether a door was visited previously or belongs to an unvisited house.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modifies door states in-place with O(1) extra variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverages the upper bound k to establish a known state before counting.
